{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Convert batch-B values from µg/L to ng/mL: divide by 10
df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngmL'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_ngmL'] /= 10

# Compute the mean of biomarker_final in ng/mL
mean_biomarker_final_ngmL = df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngmL'].mean()

print(f'Mean biomarker_final (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final_ngmL}')"}
